input.subject: Documents needed to complete your supplier registration
input.body:
Dear Reem,

Thank you for your registration. To complete it we need two documents:

1. GOSI certificate: the social_insurance.pdf you sent is unreadable, so we could not use it. Please send a clear, legible copy.
2. Zakat certificate: this was not received. Please send a copy.

Please reply to this email with both documents attached.

Kind regards,
Procurement Team
